editorial:
You know those movies where a regular guy decides to play hero and everything goes sideways? Hero Wanted is exactly that kind of ride. Liam Case is a garbage man who feels stuck in life, and when he falls for a bank teller, he cooks up a wild plan to stage a robbery so he can swoop in and save her. It sounds crazy, and it is, but that is what makes it fun to watch. The movie has a gritty, street-level feel that keeps you pulled in from the start.

The action scenes are solid and the pacing keeps things moving without dragging. Cuba Gooding Jr. brings a lot of energy to Liam, making you root for him even when his choices are questionable. The story does get a bit messy in the middle, and some twists feel rushed, but the overall experience is entertaining. If you enjoy crime thrillers with a flawed hero and a few surprises, this one is worth your time. endingExplained: In the final scenes, Liam discovers that his partner in the staged heist has been working with real criminals the whole time. The plan was never just about impressing the girl. Liam ends up badly hurt and in the hospital, realizing his attempt to be a hero only made things worse. The twist reveals that the people he trusted were using him as a pawn. In the end, Liam survives but is left broken, understanding that playing hero in a world of real crime comes with a heavy price.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with flawed heroes and twisty plots.
